en.title: The Moonlit Underground Library and the Blue Bookmark of Wishes
en.premise: In a seaside town, there exists an "Underground Library" where the memories of people sleep in the form of books. One summer, Nico, a member of the library committee, discovers that the "Blue Bookmark"—the cherished guardian of the library—has vanished. From the perspectives of Teto, a cafe owner; Lulu, a mysterious girl from afar; and Momo, the manager, they trace the missing bookmark's trail as the town prepares for its festival. It is a gentle mystery about a small act of kindness that had lost its way.

zh.title: 月光下的地下書庫與傳遞願望的青色書籤
zh.premise: 在一個海邊小鎮，流傳著一座人們的回憶化作書籍沉睡其中的「地下圖書館」。某個夏天，圖書委員尼可發現，被視為圖書館守護神般重要的「青色書籤」失蹤了。經營咖啡廳的特托、不知從何而來的少女露露，以及管理員莫莫。在準備祭典的小鎮中，他們各自以不同的視角，追尋著失蹤書籤的足跡。這是一個關於某人微小的溫柔迷失方向的，溫馨的解謎故事。
